title: ephedra andina var. humilis
intro: Ephedra andina var. humilis, commonly known as a species of the Ephedra genus, is a type of evergreen shrub native to South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing respiratory symptoms, such as congestion and asthma, due to its bronchodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ephedra andina var. humilis include increasing blood pressure and acting as a decongestant, which may be beneficial for individuals with respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and norpseudoephedrine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
